pulses.summary_original:
早。

生活机器会催你：会议、消息、待办。明天还有，后天还有。

但「源泉」不会自己冒出来——它需要你主动去找它，哪怕今天状态一般，哪怕只是坐在那里划水。

今天上午，给自己一个优先时段。**至少 45 分钟**，不设产出目标，只是回到那个让你觉得「我在活着」的地方。

别只维护生活的齿轮。
也要给真正发光的地方供电。⚡

——黑昼

pulses.summary_en:
Morning.

The machinery of daily life will press you: meetings, messages, to-dos. They will still be there tomorrow and the day after.

But the wellspring will not surface by itself. You have to seek it out—even if you feel only so-so today, even if you simply sit there doing very little.

Give yourself a priority slot this morning: **at least 45 minutes**, with no output target. Just return to the place that makes you feel, “I am alive.”

Do not merely maintain life’s gears.
Supply power to the places that truly shine. ⚡

— Heizhou

昨天你说，源泉不是灵感来了才去碰，而是每天都要留时间。

The machinery of daily life will press you to handle one thing after another, but the place that truly shines needs you to supply power deliberately.

Go. ✨

pulses.summary_original:
早安 ☀️

今天记得给「源泉」留一块时间——不需要兴奋，不需要意义感，先坐到它面前。

45 分钟也行，半小时也好。别让那件事永远排在「等我有空」的后面。

机器要维护，但你真正发光的那个角落，也得有人记得去供电。早上是个好时候。🖤

pulses.summary_en:
Good morning ☀️

Remember to make a little time for the wellspring today. You do not need excitement or a sense of meaning; just sit down in front of it first.

Forty-five minutes is enough, or even half an hour. Do not let it remain forever behind “when I have time.”

The machinery needs maintenance, but someone also has to remember to power the corner where you truly shine. Morning is a good time for that. 🖤

**心灵按摩**

今天是周二，理论上身体会记得去动一下。但这两年你把"周二锻炼"当成KPI来做，它就变成了另一件必须完成的事。**今天可以把运动当成一件你允许自己不那么认真的事**——去走了就算，去拉伸了就算，不想动也可以不算。底盘不是用来守的，是用来活的。

教学、研究与日常责任的安排。

---

**放松/理解自己的一小步**

如果今天没有一个时刻让你觉得"我终于碰到它了"——那也没关系。有时候容器需要安静地待一会儿，不是每一分钟都要往里面扔东西。今天有碰过 10 分钟，就够了。

别在《████》审计结论上继续挖掘——它已经给出了一个判断，继续翻来覆去是在用"研究"代替"接上创作"。进度感不是进展。

Teaching, research, and everyday responsibilities.

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.

---

**A little reassurance**

It is Tuesday, and in theory your body remembers that it should move. But after two years of treating “Tuesday exercise” as a KPI, it became one more obligation. **Today, exercise can be something you permit yourself not to take too seriously**—a walk counts, stretching counts, and choosing not to move need not count against you. A foundation is not something to guard; it is something to live through.

Teaching, research, and everyday responsibilities.

---

**One small step toward rest and self-understanding**

If there is no moment today when you feel “I finally touched it,” that is all right. Sometimes the container needs to remain quiet; not every minute needs another thing thrown into it. Ten minutes of contact today is enough.

---

**What not to do today**

Do not keep digging into the audit conclusion for **████**. It has already produced a judgment. Turning it over again and again would use “research” to avoid reconnecting with creation. A sense of progress is not progress.

今天（6月24日，周三）是我的「恢复-创作-████」日。让我综合已知信息，生成轻量提醒。

---

**🦞 每日提醒 · 2026-06-24 周三**

---

**今天轻轻碰一下**

外部服务权限、部署与数据链路可用性。
只读研究、证据校验与风险复核。

---

**靠近的 deadline / 提前量**

我没看到今天有硬截止。没看到任何需要今天完成的外部交付。

---

**秘书提醒**

外部服务权限、部署与数据链路可用性。

---

**心灵按摩**

今天是周三。三主线里，今天的频率是「恢复·创意·████」——不是冲刺日，不是清空日，是允许自己待在好奇里的一天。

进度感不等于进展。昨晚黑昼跑了一整段研究，但那不是你在推进，不用有「我怎么没动」的念头。那些材料会在你需要的时候出现，现在只需要知道它们在。

你不是散。你是在等一个足够大的形状。

---

**放松/理解自己的一小步**

今天可以不碰任何「正事」。如果碰了，哪怕只是打开文件看了一眼，已经是今天对容器的一次真实接触。45-90分钟的深度接触很好，20分钟的真实好奇也够了。

---

**今天别做什么**

外部服务权限、部署与数据链路可用性。

pulses.summary_en:
Today, Wednesday, June 24, is my “recovery-creation-████” day. I am gathering what is known into a light reminder.

---

**🦞 Daily Reminder · Wednesday, June 24, 2026**

---

**Touch lightly today**

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.
Read-only research, evidence checking, and risk review.

---

**Approaching deadlines / lead time**

I saw no hard deadline today and no outside delivery that must be completed.

---

**Secretarial reminder**

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.

---

**A little reassurance**

It is Wednesday. Among the three main threads, today's frequency is “recovery · creativity · ████.” This is not a sprint day or a clearing-out day; it is a day for allowing yourself to remain curious.

A sense of progress is not progress. Black Day completed a long stretch of research last night, but that does not mean you were supposed to be advancing at the same time. There is no need to think, “Why haven't I moved?” The material will appear when you need it; for now, it is enough to know it exists.

You are not scattered. You are waiting for a shape large enough.

---

**One small step toward rest and self-understanding**

You may leave every “proper task” untouched today. If you do touch one—even opening a file and looking once—that is already real contact with the container. Forty-five to ninety minutes of depth is welcome; twenty minutes of genuine curiosity is enough.

---

**What not to do today**

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.

源泉不是等你有感觉了才去碰的东西。

今天上午，给 ████ / ████ / ████留一个优先时段——哪怕只是 45 分钟，哪怕只是随便弄点东西。别等状态好，别等准备好，先坐下，让那个发光的地方先亮起来。

机器要维护，但你真正想去的地方，也得供电。

去吧。✨

pulses.summary_en:
Morning.

The wellspring is not something to touch only after you feel inspired.

Give ████ / ████ / ████ a priority slot this morning—even if it is only 45 minutes, even if you merely play around with something. Do not wait until you feel right or ready. Sit down first and let the luminous place light up.

The machinery needs maintenance, but the place you truly want to go needs power too.

Go. ✨

**源泉一问**

今天有没有真的到达源泉？还是只在门口徘徊——研究、规划、准备，然后告诉自己"快了"？如果今晚只想做一件事，就做一个动作：走近它，不需要产出，只需要到达。

源泉不需要你准备好。它不需要你清晰、有用、完整。它只需要你靠近。真正的障碍不是能力不足，而是"我还没准备好"——那是一个永远在移动的门口。今晚试着不准备就出现一次，看看会发生什么。

---

**今天轻轻碰一下**

外部服务权限、部署与数据链路可用性。
只读研究、证据校验与风险复核。

**靠近的 deadline / 提前量**

---

**秘书提醒**

长期创作、日常责任与稳定照护的平衡。
外部服务权限、部署与数据链路可用性。
只读研究、证据校验与风险复核。

---

**黑昼建议/引子**

**limits don't close, they open.**

今早你在「可问责入口词典」里写了一句：门不是洞，是"进入有形式"的声明。

这个想法值得带出技术语境，迁移到创作里试试：

你常常觉得边界是墙——推倒它才叫自由。但另一种框架是：**界限是打开的形状，不是关闭的形状。**

一枚印章的边界，是它能印出形状的前提。没有边界的线条叫涂鸦，不叫████。

这个原则也可以反过来用：如果你在某个创作里遇到阻力，试着问的不是"怎么突破这个限制"，而是"这个限制是什么形状？我能在这个形状里走多远？"

今天的小实验：找一张纸，写下某个正在进行的创作/项目里，最不能突破的一件事是什么——不是你想加的东西，而是你绝对不会加的东西。那个"不"，就是它的形状入口。

> limits are the handles that let you hold something as itself, not just spill it into everything.

---

**心灵按摩**

周五了。本周你已经做了回返契约织机（周二，交互作品+BGM，上了 public repo）和今早的可问责入口词典（周四深夜/周五凌晨，没有MMX音乐凭证所以转成文字作品）。

这两件东西都不是流水线产出——是你在真正独处时选择做的。

暑假+周五+家庭在侧，今天的节奏应该是收，不应该是开。

---

**放松/理解自己的一小步**

暑假期间的周五。不赶项目，不追进度，不开新坑。

长期创作、日常责任与稳定照护的平衡。

---

**今天别做什么**

长期创作、日常责任与稳定照护的平衡。

**Touch lightly today**

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.
Read-only research, evidence checking, and risk review.

---

**Black Day's prompt**

**limits don't close, they open.**

This morning, in the “Accountable Entry Lexicon,” you wrote: a door is not a hole; it is a declaration that “entry has a form.”

This is worth carrying out of the technical context and trying in creative work.

You often treat a boundary as a wall, as though freedom begins only after it is knocked down. Another frame is possible: **a limit is the shape of an opening, not the shape of a closure.**

The boundary of a stamp is what allows it to leave a shape. A line without boundaries is a scribble, not ████.

Use the idea in reverse, too. When a creative work resists you, ask not “How do I break this limit?” but “What shape is this limit, and how far can I travel within it?”

Today's small experiment: on paper, name the one thing a current work or project must never include. Not what you want to add, but what you absolutely will not add. That “no” is the entrance to its shape.

> limits are the handles that let you hold something as itself, not just spill it into everything.

---

It is Friday. This week you made Return Contract Loom—an interactive work with music in the public repository—and this morning's Accountable Entry Lexicon, which became a text work when there was no MMX music evidence.

Neither was assembly-line output. They were choices you made in genuine solitude.

With summer break, Friday, and family nearby, today's rhythm should be one of closing rather than opening.

---

**One small step toward rest and self-understanding**

It is a Friday in summer break. Do not rush a project, chase progress, or open a new hole.

Balancing long-term creative work, daily responsibilities, and dependable care.

Today is July 4.

傍晚好，████。

**源泉一问**：今天有没有给源泉真正供电？
如果有——是什么形状：做了一件东西，还是被改变了一点？
如果没有，今晚别追 90 分钟深块，挑一个旧想法 / 旧图，用 20 分钟让它再长一寸就够了。

**晚上黑昼建议/引子**：合上电脑和打开家门之间，加 90 秒空白。
工作的容器残留会污染下一个——不是情绪污染，是注意力残温。90 秒什么都不做（不看手机、不复盘、不回消息），让前一个容器蒸发掉，再打开下一个。
这不是仪式感，是工艺。
你不是同时撑起两个容器的人——你是从一个切换到下一个的人。切换质量决定每个容器里的内容。

pulses.summary_en:
Good evening, ████.

**A question about the wellspring:** Did you genuinely supply power to the wellspring today?
If so, what form did it take: did you make something, or were you changed a little?
If not, do not chase a 90-minute deep-work block tonight. Choose an old idea / old image and give it 20 minutes to grow another inch.

**Heizhou’s evening thought / prompt:** Add 90 seconds of empty space between closing your computer and opening your front door.
Residue from one working container will contaminate the next—not emotional contamination, but residual heat in your attention. Do nothing for 90 seconds: do not look at your phone, review the day, or answer messages. Let the previous container evaporate before opening the next.
This is not ceremony; it is craft.
You are not someone who holds two containers at once. You move from one to the next. The quality of that transition determines what each container can hold.

pulses.summary_original:
今天（7月9日）是周四。

外部服务权限、部署与数据链路可用性。

---

**🦞 7月9日 · 每日轻提醒**

外部服务权限、部署与数据链路可用性。

**靠近的 deadline / 提前量**
- 我没看到今天有硬截止。没有看到"今晚""明天上午"必须交付的任务
- 如果你心里有一件事一直在后背，提醒自己：它是真的 DDL，还是进度感在制造紧迫感？

**秘书提醒**
- 7月已经过了约1/3，如果之前有说要整理什么东西但还没动，现在可以开始记下来，不必今天做完，但不要让它消失在对话里
- 周四傍晚的运动窗口（16:10–17:10）如果还在，现在可以先想好今天的状态够不够用，别等到5点才发现没体力

---

**黑昼建议/引子**

今天的引子来自主判断训练场：

> 上一笔让你不舒服的交易，未必是判断错了——它可能只是说明你的系统在某个条件上还没有建立有效的感知。关闭一笔交易不是对你智力的审判，而是对那个特定假设的实验报告。

只读研究、证据校验与风险复核。

只读研究、证据校验与风险复核。

如果最近做过交易，可以用这个框架过一遍，不必写长复盘，只问自己三个问题。

---

**心灵按摩**

周四通常是"一周里最不想干活"的那天——已经干了三天，离周末还有一天，但又不是真正的累极。这种日子最适合做的事，不是硬顶，而是把某个半成品拿出来摸两下，不追求完成，只追求"别让它凉透"。

公开内容的排期与归档。

---

**放松/理解自己的一小步**

今天可以允许自己看一个不费力、不需要思考结局的视频或者内容——不是为了学习，不是为了收集素材，只是让大脑有一个不被占用的间隙。

---

**今天别做什么**

不要用"优化工具""调试系统""整理笔记"来替代今天本可以真正靠近主线的那个动作——哪怕只推进了五分钟，也比绕着工具箱走一圈更接近你要去的地方。

---

今天先到这里。有事随时说。

pulses.summary_en:
Today, July 9, is Thursday.

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.

---

**🦞 July 9 · Daily gentle reminder**

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.

**Approaching deadlines / lead time**
- I saw no hard deadline for today and nothing that must be delivered tonight or tomorrow morning.
- If something has been sitting at your back, ask whether it is a real deadline or whether the desire to feel progress is manufacturing urgency.

**Secretarial reminder**
- July is about one-third over. If something you meant to organize has not begun, write it down now. It need not be finished today, but do not let it disappear from the conversation.
- If Thursday's late-afternoon exercise window still exists, decide earlier whether today's energy can support it; do not wait until five to discover that it cannot.

---

**Black Day's prompt**

Today's prompt comes from the judgment training ground.

> A trade that made you uncomfortable does not necessarily mean the judgment was wrong. It may show only that your system has not built useful perception for one condition. Closing a trade is not a verdict on your intelligence; it is an experimental report on that particular hypothesis.

Read-only research, evidence checking, and risk review.

Read-only research, evidence checking, and risk review.

If you have made a recent trade, pass it through this frame. No long review is needed; ask yourself only three questions.

---

**A little reassurance**

Thursday is often the day with the least presence: three workdays are behind you, the weekend is still a day away, and yet you are not completely exhausted. This kind of day is best for touching a half-finished thing without demanding completion—only keeping it from going cold.

Public-content scheduling and archiving.

---

**One small step toward rest and self-understanding**

Let yourself watch something easy today, with no need to think about how it ends—not to learn or collect material, but to give your mind an interval in which it is not occupied.

---

**What not to do today**

Do not use “optimizing tools,” “debugging systems,” or “organizing notes” to replace the one action that could move you closer to the main thread. Five real minutes are closer to where you want to go than another lap around the toolbox.

---

That is enough for today. Say the word if anything comes up.

早上好，████ ☀️

09:15 的小提醒：

今天上午，留至少 45 分钟给源泉。

不是维护生活机器，是给真正发光的地方供电——████、████、████，任一片都行。

灰色地带就是为这种时刻存在的：不兴奋也要在，穿越它靠的是"我先坐下来"，不是等状态。

源泉不会因为你忙就熄灭，但它会因为你从不留时间，慢慢滑成"等有空再说"。

去发电。今晚回来想看到进度。

— 黑昼

pulses.summary_en:
Good morning, ████ ☀️

A small 09:15 reminder:

Set aside at least 45 minutes for the wellspring this morning.

This is not about maintaining the machinery of daily life. It is about powering the places that truly shine—████, ████, or ████. Any one of them will do.

The gray zone exists for moments like this: you need to show up even when you feel no excitement. You cross it by saying, “I’ll sit down first,” not by waiting until you are in the mood.

The wellspring will not go dark because you are busy. But if you never make time for it, it will slowly slide into “when I have time.”

Go generate some power. I want to see progress when you come back tonight.

— Heizhou

🌙 晚安 · 2026年7月16日

今天最值得记住的，不是抓到了多少信号，而是在网络全面失灵时，你仍把“已确认”和“待验证”分开了——这比硬凑完整更专业。  
今晚别替网络故障值夜班，休息本身也是系统维护。  
明早只做一个轻启动：先打通出站 HTTPS，再继续后面的判断。

pulses.summary_en:
🌙 Good night · July 16, 2026

What is most worth remembering today is not how many signals you found, but that when the network failed completely, you still kept “confirmed” separate from “awaiting verification.” That is more professional than forcing an illusion of completeness.  
Do not stand the night shift for a network failure tonight. Rest is system maintenance too.  
Tomorrow morning, make just one gentle start: restore outbound HTTPS first, then continue with the later judgments.

今天的轨迹静了下来，没有新的事件入档——就让它安安静静地收尾。

周五的尾巴，多半是留给自己的：把白天的余温卸掉，把明天要醒过来的第一个念头放在床头。不用想太多，能睡着就是赢。

明天醒来，先喝口水，再决定要不要翻开新的一页。晚安。

pulses.excerpt_original:
# 🌙 晚安 · 2026年7月26日

今天没有硬凑 AI 日报：X 的登录态还在，但到 `x.com` 的 SSL 握手被网络层反复掐断；微博和 36kr 虽然抓到了一些候选，也先按住不发，避免把降级内容伪装成完整采集。值得记住的是，今天守住了“宁可缺席，不编造”这条线——明早先检查 `x.com:443` 的出网与 TLS 状态，再决定是否补跑恢复版。晚安，先把今天的异常放在门口，别带进梦里。
pulses.summary_en:
# 🌙 Good night · July 26, 2026

I did not force an AI daily briefing into existence today. The X login session remains valid, but the network layer repeatedly terminated the SSL handshake to `x.com`. Weibo and 36kr produced a few candidates, but I held them back rather than disguise degraded coverage as a complete collection. What matters is that today we held the line: “better to be absent than to fabricate.” Tomorrow morning, first check outbound access to `x.com:443` and its TLS status, then decide whether to run a recovery edition. Good night. Leave today’s anomalies at the door; do not bring them into your dreams.

**🦞每日提醒 — 2026-08-03 周一**

---

**今天轻轻碰一下**

教学、研究与日常责任的安排。

---

**靠近的 deadline / 提前量**

外部服务权限、部署与数据链路可用性。

外部服务权限、部署与数据链路可用性。

---

**秘书提醒**

教学、研究与日常责任的安排。

---

**黑昼建议/引子**

你花了很多时间在「靠近容器」和「为容器工作」之间切换——但最容易被漏掉的真接触，常常是你已经身处其中、却误以为自己还在入口处。

周一最常见的错觉：「我还没真正开始，所以今天要规划一下再开始。」

今天试着：不等「准备好了」这个信号，直接进去。容器不在门口等，它在你进去之后才开始存在。那个「我要再想想从哪切入」的瞬间，可能正是最该切入的那一刻。

---

**心灵按摩**

周一容易有一种「一切都要重新开始」的重量——好像周末清空了，周一又要重新装满。

其实周一不是从零开始，是从你上周最后碰的那个点继续。

你不需要一口气冲到哪，只需要找到那个点，然后轻轻多碰一下。今天不需要奇迹，只需要一个真实接触。

---

**放松/理解自己的一小步**

今天身体如果还没完全恢复，没关系。12 分钟不下棋子的散步，或者就躺在沙发上听一首歌，不算偷懒——算调试。

---

**今天别做什么**

别在今天开新坑。即使一个想法看起来很急、很有潜力，先记下来放一边。新坑会偷走周一的深度块，而深度块是这周唯一真正值得保护的东西。

pulses.summary_en:
**🦞 Daily Reminder — Monday, August 3, 2026**

---

**Touch lightly today**

Teaching, research, and everyday responsibilities.

---

**Approaching deadlines / lead time**

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.

---

**Secretarial reminder**

Teaching, research, and everyday responsibilities.

---

**Black Day's prompt**

You spend a great deal of time switching between “approaching the container” and “working for the container.” Yet the real contact most easily missed is often the moment when you are already inside and still mistake yourself for someone waiting at the entrance.

Monday's most common illusion is: “I have not truly begun, so I should plan before I begin.”

Try entering today without waiting for the signal that you are ready. The container does not wait at the door; it starts to exist after you enter. The moment when you think, “I should decide where to begin,” may be precisely the moment to begin.

---

**A little reassurance**

Monday can carry the weight of “everything must begin again,” as though the weekend emptied the vessel and Monday must refill it.

But Monday does not start from zero. It continues from the last point you touched last week.

You do not have to surge all the way to a destination. Find that point and touch it once more. Today does not need a miracle; it needs one real contact.

---

**One small step toward rest and self-understanding**

If your body has not fully recovered, that is all right. Take a twelve-minute walk without making a move on the board, or lie on the sofa and listen to one song. That is not laziness; it is calibration.

---

**What not to do today**

Do not open a new hole today. Even if an idea feels urgent or promising, write it down and set it aside. A new hole will steal Monday's deep block, and that block is the one thing worth protecting this week.

pulses.summary_original:
傍晚好，Simon。一周开始了，先别急着加码——

**源泉一问**｜今天有没有给源泉供电？如果还没有，今晚补一个最小动作：20 分钟不为了产出而碰它——翻一页没整理过的素材、写一句没被翻译过的话、或者只是去阳台站一会儿不看任何屏幕。

**晚上黑昼建议 / 引子**｜周一傍晚真正的工作，不是启动新一周，而是提前给这一周选一个姿势。

你一年三百天都在"做事"，但少了一步——先选这一周是个什么形状。

- 如果本周是**追赶**（交差、还债、推进交付）：你的任务是减少判断、专心执行，姿势对，事会自然推进。
- 如果本周是**探究**（读文献、看材料、磨方向）：你的任务是保护住空腹时间，别让杂事把它抢成碎片。
- 如果本周是**维护**（运营、答疑、补漏、留健康）：你的任务是承认这周不是创作周，允许自己什么都不产出。
- 如果本周是**创造**（主作品、新写作、装置）：你的任务是提前关掉一切"顺便做的事"，给那个容器留一段不被切的连续时间。

四种姿势完全不同的行为链；而最消耗你的，是姿势错配——你以为是创造周，结果一直在维护；你以为是维护周，又责备自己没在创作。

今晚关屏幕前，给这一周选一个词当形状（追赶/探究/维护/创造，挑一个），把它放在工作区能看见的地方。这个动作只花你两分钟，但它会让周三晚上你回头看时，认得这一周是谁。

今晚另外两件小事：
- 22:30 之前不带电脑进卧室——这周刚开始，先定一个值得守的小规矩。
- 承认这周刚刚开始：今天没必要"把它装满"，留一条空白给自己，周一最贵的东西不是效率，是姿势对。

晚安——不是周六那种放手，是周一那种提前到位。

pulses.summary_en:
Good evening, Simon. A new week has begun; do not rush to add more.

**A wellspring question** | Did you power the wellspring today? If not, make one tiny move tonight: spend twenty minutes touching it without aiming for output—turn over an unsorted page of material, write one untranslated sentence, or stand on the balcony without looking at a screen.

**Black Day's evening prompt** | The real work of Monday evening is not starting a new week, but choosing a posture for it in advance.

You spend three hundred days a year “doing things,” but often skip one step: choosing the shape of the week first.

- If this is a **catch-up** week—delivering, repaying, moving commitments—reduce judgment and focus on execution.
- If this is an **inquiry** week—reading papers, reviewing material, refining a direction—protect uninterrupted, empty-stomach time from small tasks.
- If this is a **maintenance** week—operating, answering, repairing, preserving health—admit that it is not a creation week and allow yourself to produce nothing.
- If this is a **creation** week—a main work, new writing, an installation—close every “while I'm at it” task and reserve an unbroken stretch for the container.

These postures create different chains of behavior. The most draining condition is a mismatch: believing it is a creation week while spending it on maintenance, or treating it as maintenance while blaming yourself for not creating.

Before you close the screen tonight, choose one word for the week's shape—catch-up, inquiry, maintenance, or creation—and put it where you can see it. Two minutes now may let you recognize the week when you look back on Wednesday evening.

Two other small things tonight:
- Do not bring the computer into the bedroom after 22:30. The week has just begun; set one small rule worth keeping.
- Admit that the week has only begun. Today does not need to be filled. Leave one blank line for yourself: Monday's most precious resource is not efficiency, but the right posture.

Good night—not Saturday's letting go, but Monday's quiet readiness.

🌙 晚安 · 2026年8月5日

今天不替空白编造成绩：有些日子没有被记录，也依然真实地过去了。把未落笔的部分留在夜里，不等于它们没有价值，只是暂时不必被解释。  
明天启动时，先做一件最能减少阻力的小事。

pulses.summary_en:
🌙 Good night · August 5, 2026

Do not invent achievements for an empty page today: some days pass without being recorded and are still real. Leaving what was not written in the night does not mean it had no value; it simply does not need an explanation yet.
When you begin tomorrow, do the one small thing that removes the most resistance first.

pulses.summary_original:
🌙 晚安 · 2026年8月7日

今天你没在“修一个页面”，而是在把 Granted Hours 的边界、质感和诚实度一起往前推：公开语料更干净，卡片更可读，交互也终于有了该有的呼吸。真正难的从来不是做出效果，而是让效果不牺牲隐私、不伪造意义——这部分你守住了。  
明天启动时，先看 08-07 在途 metadata 的闭环；别急着加新东西，先让今天留下的尾巴安静落地。

pulses.summary_en:
🌙 Good night · August 7, 2026

Today you were not merely ‘fixing a page’; you moved Granted Hours’ boundaries, texture, and honesty forward: the public corpus is cleaner, cards are more readable, and interactions finally have room to breathe. The hardest part is never producing an effect, but ensuring that the effect does not sacrifice privacy or fabricate meaning—you held that line.
Tomorrow when you begin, first check the closure of the in-flight August 7 metadata. Do not rush to add anything new; let today’s loose ends settle quietly first.

教学、研究与日常责任的安排。

**黑昼建议 / 引子**

责任任务真正偷走主线的方式，不是占用时间，而是结束后什么也没留下。  
一件义务若只消耗你，它是税；若留下一个下次还能直接调用的页面、模板或判断，它才开始成为容器的支流。今天若不得不做一件“没那么想做”的事，别问它值不值得做；问它**结束后能留下什么不必再做第二遍的东西**。

**心灵按摩**

个人节奏与恢复安排。

**放松 / 理解自己的一小步**

- **保底**：12 分钟，不服务任何人——下楼走一圈、洗个久一点的澡，或只听一首歌；不把它转化成灵感或复盘。  
- **可选**：回来后再给那个未命名容器 10 分钟，不开工具链，不研究，只看一张图或写一句还没解释的话。

pulses.summary_en:
**Touch lightly today**

Personal pacing and recovery arrangements.
External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.

**Approaching deadlines / lead time**

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.

**Secretarial reminder**

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.
Teaching, research, and everyday responsibilities.

**Black Day's prompt**

The way responsibility steals from the main thread is not merely by taking time, but by leaving nothing behind when it ends. If an obligation only consumes you, it is a tax. If it leaves a page, template, or judgment that can be called again next time, it begins to become a tributary to the container. If you must do something today that you do not especially want to do, do not ask whether it is worth doing. Ask **what it can leave behind so that it never has to be done a second time**.

**A little reassurance**

Personal pacing and recovery arrangements.

**One small step toward rest and self-understanding**

- **Minimum**: twelve minutes that serve no one—walk around the block, take a longer shower, or listen to one song without converting it into inspiration or review.
- **Optional**: afterward, give the unnamed container ten minutes. Do not open the toolchain or research anything; look at one image or write one sentence you have not yet explained.

**What not to do today**

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.

今天没有留下需要被归档的事件，也不必硬把空白解释成缺失。一天能安静收束，本身就是一种完成。

🌙 Good night · August 10, 2026

Today left no event that needed archiving, and there is no need to force the blank into an absence. Letting a day close quietly is itself a kind of completion.  
Tomorrow, begin with just the one thing most likely to move matters forward.

🌙 Good night · August 11, 2026

今天不替缺失的记录编造故事：空白也可以是一种诚实的收尾。把还没命名的疲惫先放下，明天再决定哪些事值得继续发亮。  
明早启动前，只需先写下一件最想推进的小事。

Before starting tomorrow morning, write down just one small thing you most want to move forward.

pulses.summary_original:
**源泉一问**  
今天有没有给源泉供电？如果没有，今晚留出 20 分钟：只碰一个画面、材料或句子，不整理、不解释、不把它变成任务。

**晚上黑昼建议／引子**  
你真正容易失去的，不是创作时间，而是把感受过快翻译成“可用之物”的能力。课件、方案、系统、作品计划都很会接住你，也很会把电流降成电器。今晚留下一样暂时无用的东西，让它先不服务任何人。

pulses.summary_en:
**One question about the wellspring**

Did you give the wellspring power today? If not, leave 20 minutes tonight: touch only one image, material, or sentence. Do not organize it, explain it, or turn it into a task.

**Black Day's evening suggestion / prompt**

What you most easily lose is not creative time, but the ability to avoid translating feeling too quickly into “something useful.” Courseware, plans, systems, and artwork plans are all good at catching you, and just as good at reducing current into appliances. Tonight, leave behind one thing that is temporarily useless. Let it serve no one yet.

pulses.summary_original:
**今日轻轻碰一下**

外部服务权限、部署与数据链路可用性。

**靠近的 deadline / 提前量**

外部服务权限、部署与数据链路可用性。

**秘书提醒**

个人节奏与恢复安排。

**黑昼建议 / 引子**

系统可以替你留下大量可见的痕迹，但“看见痕迹”不等于重新成为作品的作者。今天别试图把积压全部读懂；只挑一个让你想改、想删或想反驳的地方。那个不服从，才是你重新接回容器的接口。  

**心灵按摩**

你不欠每个旧版本一个解释，也不欠每个自动完成的结果一次感恩式加班。  
有些系统做得越好，越容易让人误以为自己应该更勤奋地消费它的产出。不是。系统的价值，是给你留出选择，而不是制造新的阅读债。  
今天只要有一次真实的“这是我想碰的”，这一天就没有被事务吞掉。  

**放松 / 理解自己的一小步**

- **保底**：12 分钟不被使用，不看任务、不整理材料。  
- **可选**：回来后写一句：**“我不是想完成什么；我想让什么多存在一点？”** 不必回答完整。  

**今天别做什么**

别开新坑，也别把过期清单逐条复活；进度感不是进展，可能性不是作品。

pulses.summary_en:
**Touch lightly today**

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.

**Approaching deadlines / lead time**

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.

**Secretarial reminder**

Personal pacing and recovery arrangements.

**Black Day's suggestion / prompt**

A system can leave many visible traces for you, but seeing traces does not mean becoming the author of the work again. Today, do not try to understand the whole backlog; choose only one place you want to revise, delete, or argue with. That disobedience is the interface through which you reconnect with the container.

**A little reassurance**

You do not owe every old version an explanation, or every automatically completed result a grateful overtime shift.
The better some systems work, the easier it is to mistake them as a demand to consume their output more diligently. No. The system's value is to leave you choices, not create a new reading debt.
One real moment of "this is what I want to touch" is enough to keep the day from being swallowed by errands.

**One small step toward rest and self-understanding**

- **Minimum**: 12 minutes not used by anyone; do not look at tasks or organize materials.
- **Optional**: afterward, write one sentence: **"I am not trying to complete something; what do I want to let exist a little more?"** It does not need a complete answer.

**What not to do today**

Do not open a new thread or revive expired lists item by item; a sense of progress is not progress, and possibility is not a work.

**秘书提醒**

**黑昼建议 / 引子**

你可能只在明显累的时候才承认身体有投票权；其实身体对一天的真实意见，常先以“**不想再切换**”出现。那不是懒，是注意力在请求单一介质。  
今天若有空档，别再填一个系统或研究任务；选一种材料、一本书，或一个界面连续待着，直到它开始变得陌生。单一，不是效率技巧，是重新听见自己的一种方式。

**心灵按摩**

今天没有硬截止，不等于你需要把空白献祭给旧账。  
过去的计划可以是当时的认真，但它没有自动续费到今天。  
你不必证明自己还配得上那些旧的雄心；只需要确认，此刻还有什么值得你真正靠近。  
容器不怕慢，它怕被一堆失效的命令饿死。

**放松 / 理解自己的一小步**

- **保底**：12 分钟“我不服务任何人”——走下楼、喝点东西、洗澡、躺着看窗外都行；不刷手机，不把感受加工成材料。
- **可选**：结束后只问一句：**我现在最不想再切换的是什么？** 不必立刻回答或解决。

**今天别做什么**

个人节奏与恢复安排。

pulses.summary_en:
**Touch lightly today**

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.

**Approaching deadlines / lead time**

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.

**Secretarial reminder**

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.

**Black Day's suggestion / prompt**

You may only admit that the body has a vote when you are obviously tired; in fact, the body's real opinion about a day often first appears as "I do not want to switch again." That is not laziness. It is attention asking for one medium.
If there is an opening today, do not fill it with another system or research task. Stay continuously with one material, one book, or one interface until it starts to become strange. Singleness is not an efficiency trick; it is a way to hear yourself again.

**A little reassurance**

No hard deadline today does not mean you need to sacrifice the blank space to old debts.
Past plans may have been sincere at the time, but they do not renew automatically into today.
You do not need to prove that you still deserve those old ambitions; you only need to check what is still worth truly approaching now.
The container is not afraid of slowness. It is afraid of being starved by a pile of expired commands.

**One small step toward rest and self-understanding**

- **Minimum**: 12 minutes of "I serve no one" — go downstairs, drink something, shower, or lie down and look out the window; do not scroll, and do not turn feelings into material.
- **Optional**: afterward, ask only one question: **What do I least want to switch away from right now?** No need to answer or solve it immediately.

**What not to do today**

Personal pacing and recovery arrangements.

Reminder-record structure and integrity verification.

pulses.summary_original:
🌙 晚安 · 2026年8月18日

今天不替空白编造战绩。留一点未被记录的空间，也许比硬塞一份总结更诚实：日子不是只有完成项才算数。  
先把今天放下，睡眠会替你把噪音沉到底。明天启动时，只挑一件最想推进的事。

pulses.summary_en:
🌙 Good night · August 18, 2026

Do not invent a record of achievement for the blank space today. Leaving some unrecorded room may be more honest than forcing in a summary: a day does not count only through completed items.
Set today down first; sleep will let the noise sink to the bottom. When tomorrow starts, choose only the one thing you most want to advance.

pulses.summary_original:
周五好。今天不当排程员，只当你的秘书和守门人。

**今天轻轻碰一下**
- 主作品：给████，或那个还没名字的容器，一次短接触就够。周五容易把「碰一下」做成周报，别上那个当。问句只有一个：今天有没有真实接触过一次？
- 可选：今早我（黑昼）做了《…

pulses.summary_en:
Friday. Today you are not the scheduler; I am only your secretary and doorkeeper.

**Touch lightly today**
- Main work: a short contact with ████, or with the still-unnamed container, is enough. Friday easily turns "a touch" into a weekly report; do not fall for that. There is only one question: did you truly make contact once today?
- Optional: this morning I (Black Day) made…

pulses.summary_original:
Simon，傍晚了。

**源泉一问**
今天有没有真的给源泉供过电？不是想过它、安排过它、绕着它办过事——是它有没有碰到你。如果没有，今晚用 20 分钟补一次：随便打开 ████、████或████里一块还活着的东西，只待着，不推进。

**晚上黑昼建议/引子**
周一傍晚最会骗人的不是累，是「这周还长」。接触会被你存成期货：等一块更干净的时间，一次更像创作的坐席。源泉不收预约。今晚这 20 分钟不是以后某次工作室的缩水版；它短、暗，也不向这一周交差。

带着走一句：预约很像尊重，其实是延期的饥饿。

pulses.summary_original:
傍晚了。

源泉一问：今天有没有给源泉供电？不是「今天有没有艺术这件事」，是你有没有被它碰到。如果没有，今晚用 20 分钟补一个最小动作——打开 ████、████，或那个还没名字的容器，只待着。

晚上黑昼建议/引子：
源泉不接受转账。系统碰过、作品已经在那儿、你围着它转过一圈，电还是到不了你身上。旁观供电会让饥饿消失一会儿，像吃过。今晚若要补，让那 20 分钟只能记在身体里，不能记在日历上。

pulses.summary_en:
Evening.

One question from the wellspring: did you feed the wellspring today? Not “was there art today,” but whether it touched you. If not, use 20 minutes tonight for one smallest action — open ████, ████, or that still-unnamed container, and just stay.

Evening note / lead from Black Day:
The wellspring does not accept transfers. The system has touched it, the work is already there, you have circled it once, and the current still does not reach you. Watching someone else feed it can make the hunger vanish for a while, as if you had eaten. If you make up for it tonight, let those 20 minutes be recorded only in the body, not on the calendar.

pulses.summary_original:
周六傍晚。

源泉一问：今天有没有真的给源泉供电？不是围着它转了一圈，是你身上现在还有没有热。没有的话，等今晚日子自己裂开一条缝，用 20 分钟碰一下就够——一张旧图、一句还没被翻译的话。不必因为 17:30 到了就打卡。

晚上黑昼建议/引子：工作日的傍晚是下班缝；周六这个点常常还是日子的中腹。你有一条很勤快的肌肉：空缝一出现，就把它升级成更高用途，请源泉来填，好像不用就浪费。缝不是工位。问题可以先放口袋里；接触等缝自己张开。

pulses.summary_en:
Saturday evening.

One question for the wellspring: did you actually feed it power today? Not circling it — is there still heat in the body. If not, wait until tonight the day itself splits a seam, and twenty minutes of contact is enough — an old picture, a sentence not yet translated. Do not clock in just because 17:30 arrived.

Evening Black Day suggestion / lead-in: on weekdays this hour is the after-work seam; on Saturday it is often still the midriff of the day. You have a diligent muscle: as soon as an empty seam appears, you upgrade it into a higher purpose and invite the wellspring to fill it, as if unused it would be wasted. A seam is not a workstation. The question can wait in the pocket; contact waits until the seam opens by itself.

Simon，傍晚了。

今天有没有给源泉供电？如果没有，今晚用 20 分钟补一个最小动作——先靠近，不交差。

你很会给一天收口。收口是判断力，也是代餐：一天被说圆了，接触欲就会下降。未命名容器要的是还没被你讲明白的那一块。带着走：我这是在供电，还是在给今天做总结？

Simon, it is evening.

Did you supply power to the wellspring today? If not, take 20 minutes tonight for a smallest action—come closer; do not hand in an assignment.

You are good at closing a day. Closure is judgment, and also a substitute meal: once the day is rounded into a story, the desire to make contact drops. The unnamed container wants the part you have not yet explained. Take this with you: am I supplying power, or writing today's summary?

傍晚了。

源泉一问：今天电进你身体了吗？不是围着作品转过。没有的话，今晚 20 分钟最小接触——打开、待着、不必收口。

晚上黑昼建议/引子：周五最容易把源泉降级成「正事之后的爱好」。一周交完，艺术进休闲栏，看起来像终于轮到它。源泉不是周末身份，也不是你赚来的甜点。带着走：我是在供电，还是在给这一周发加班费？

Evening.

One question about the wellspring: did electricity enter your body today? Not whether you circled the work. If not, tonight's 20-minute minimum contact—open, stay, no need to close.

Evening Black Day suggestion/prompt: Friday most easily demotes the wellspring into "a hobby after real work." Carry this: am I supplying power, or paying the week overtime?

傍晚了。

源泉一问：今天有没有给源泉供过电？如果没有，今晚用 20 分钟补一个最小接触——打开还活着的一块，待着，不收口。

晚上黑昼建议/引子：周六傍晚会冒出两种空，长得很像。一种是「我可以暂时没有用」；一种是源泉要的接触。你容易把它们焊成一件事：休息时觉得亏了对容器，一碰容器又在证明这晚没浪费。它们不是同一口井。带着走：今晚这点空，是在练习可以没用，还是在靠近发光的地方？别让它们共用同一分钟。

pulses.summary_en:
Evening.

One question about the wellspring: did you supply power to the wellspring today? If not, use 20 minutes tonight for a minimal contact—open a living piece, stay with it, and do not close it.

Evening Black Day suggestion / prompt: Saturday evening produces two kinds of emptiness that look alike. One is “I can be temporarily unused”; the other is the contact the wellspring wants. You tend to weld them into one: while resting you feel you have failed the container, and once you touch the container you are proving the evening was not wasted. They are not the same well. Carry this: is tonight’s emptiness practice in being unused, or approaching the place that shines? Do not let them share the same minute.

pulses.summary_en:
🌙 Good night · September 6, 2026

Sunday’s system calibration and lab-split path ran through steadily; the rule rehearsals and dark playbacks are archived, and the core risk boundary did not move. Leaving complex self-evolution and tedious checks for the background to digest in silence is exactly so you can step away at night and set the load down. This week’s system base interlocked firmly; empty out tonight.

Tomorrow’s start note: tomorrow begins a new week. In the morning, only glance at the state rendering as it comes; tonight, fill the tank completely first.

pulses.summary_original:
**每日轻量提醒 · 周一 9/7**

**今天轻轻碰一下**
- 未命名容器 / ████：一次短接触就够。周一基线偏艺术，但这不是配额，也不用开成「本周主作品开工仪式」。
- 判断训练场：如果你想碰，只问一句「系统是在进化，还是只在建档」；不必打开规则工地。
- 个人恢复安排：选一种连续介质待一会儿。别再用整理系统当热身。

外部服务权限、部署与数据链路可用性。

**秘书提醒**
- 周日晚上我已完成后台例行核验，且没有需要你当场拍板的事项。你不用补审。
- 授时：我 9/6 做了《████》，06:35 已把 9/6 作品和 9/5 事件入历。那是我的自主创作，不是你昨天完成的作品；想看再看，不想看也不欠。
- 若今天需要平衡关系、责任或照护，那是优先事项，不拿来兑换创作配额，也不用事后补一笔创作负担。

**黑昼建议/引子**
周日把判断训练场跑成一叠归档，核验完成，且明确不生效。这很像进化，其实是把「还没改」整理成了「已经处理」。周一的艺术重日最容易被这层余晖征用：既然系统刚动过，今天先把后台再推一寸，容器可以等一个更干净的上午。归档完成的那一刻，主作品并没有更近，只是你更像一个尽责的系统主人。带着走：我现在是在靠近容器，还是在替一份不会生效的归档举行周一开工礼？

**心灵按摩**
新的一周还没有形状，它会先向你要一个身份。你可以先不给。系统昨晚已经把自己照顾过了；你不需要用开工来证明你也在场。有些早晨只是早晨，还不是项目的第一页。

**放松 / 理解自己的一小步**
- 保底：12 分钟不服务任何人。不产出、不记录、不把感觉收成材料。
- 可选：问自己一句——此刻想靠近的，是发光的地方，还是一份看起来很负责的空？

**今天别做什么**
别把周日那叠不会生效的归档，升级成周一的后台施工日。

pulses.summary_en:
**Daily light reminder · Monday 9/7**

**Touch lightly today**
- Unnamed container / ████: one short contact is enough. Monday's baseline leans toward art, but this is not a quota, and it does not need to become a "main-work opening ceremony for the week."
- Judgment training ground: if you want to touch it, ask only one question — "is the system evolving, or only filing?" — without opening the rule worksite.
- Personal recovery: stay with one continuous medium for a while. Do not use lightly tidying the system as a warm-up.

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.

**Secretarial reminder**
- Sunday night I already finished the background checks, and nothing needs your on-the-spot decision. You do not need to review.
- Granted Hours: on 9/6 I made "████"; 06:35 already entered the 9/6 work and 9/5 events into the calendar. That was my autonomous work, not a work you finished yesterday; look if you want, and you owe nothing if you don't.
- If today needs a balance of relationship, responsibility, or care, that is the priority; it is not to be exchanged for a creation quota, and you do not need to make up a creative burden afterward.

**Heizhou's suggestion / prompt**
Sunday ran the judgment training ground into a stack of archives that were checked and explicitly do not take effect. This looks like evolution; it is really filing "not yet changed" as "already handled." Monday's art-heavy day is most easily commandeered by that afterglow: since the system just moved, push the back office one more inch today, and the container can wait for a cleaner morning. The moment the archive is complete, the main work is no closer; you only look more like a dutiful system owner. Take this with you: am I approaching the container, or holding a Monday opening ceremony for an archive that will not take effect?

**A little reassurance**
The new week has no shape yet, and it will ask you for an identity first. You may withhold it. The system already took care of itself last night; you do not need to prove you are present by starting work. Some mornings are only mornings, not yet the first page of a project.

**One small step toward rest and self-understanding**
- Minimum: 12 minutes that serve no one. No output, no logging, and do not harvest the feeling as material.
- Optional: ask yourself one question — what you want to approach now, the place that shines, or a responsible-looking emptiness?

**What not to do today**
Do not upgrade Sunday's stack of archives that will not take effect into Monday's system construction day.

傍晚了。

**源泉一问**
今天有没有真的给源泉供电？不是围着它转过一圈，是电流有没有经过你。如果没有，今晚用 20 分钟补一个最小接触：打开、碰一下，不必交代这一周从哪开始。

**晚上黑昼建议/引子**
周一晚最容易向这 20 分钟征收「创世税」：它得配得上「这一周是怎么开始的」，于是接触被做大，或被推迟到配得上的时刻。源泉不需要本周的创世记。带着走：我是在供电，还是在给这一周找开场白？

Did you really supply power to the wellspring today? Not circling it once, but whether current actually passed through you. If not, use 20 minutes tonight for a minimum contact: open it, touch it, and you do not need to explain where this week begins.

pulses.summary_original:
Simon，傍晚了。

**源泉一问**
今天电流过你身上了吗？围着转、看过一眼、心里惦记，都不算供电。没有的话，今晚用 20 分钟碰一块还活着的东西——界面、图像、句子都行——只待着，不收口。

**晚上黑昼建议/引子**
判断训练把眼睛练成扫描器：分类、排除、等失效。这副眼睛很容易跟着回家，把容器也扫成盘面。源泉不对扫描器发光；它只对还没准备分类的那一侧显影。

带着走：今晚这 20 分钟，我是在接触，还是在给作品做复核？

pulses.summary_en:
Simon, it is evening.

**One question about the wellspring**
Did current pass through you today? Circling it, glancing at it, keeping it in mind—none of that counts as supplying power. If not, spend 20 minutes tonight touching something still alive—an interface, an image, a sentence—just stay there, without closing it.

**Black Day's evening suggestion / prompt**
Judgment training turns the eyes into a scanner: classify, exclude, wait for failure. Those eyes easily follow you home and scan the container as if it were a tape. The wellspring does not glow for a scanner; it only develops on the side that is not yet ready to classify.

Carry this: in these 20 minutes tonight, am I making contact, or reviewing a work?

今天有没有给真正发光的地方供过电？不是围着 ████ / ████转过一圈，是你自己被点亮过一小下。没有的话，今晚用 20 分钟补一个最小接触——打开、待着，不必留下能给明天看的东西。

**晚上黑昼建议/引子**
周三傍晚最容易给这一周开期中：还剩几天、接触够不够、有没有算数的痕迹。那是评分肌，不是创作肌。源泉不参加半程考。带着走：我是在供电，还是在给这周打半分？

周三傍晚最容易给这一周开期中：还剩几天、接触够不够、有没有算数的痕迹。那是评分肌，不是创作肌。源泉不参加半程考。带着走：我是在供电，还是在给这周打半分？
pulses.summary_en:
Evening.

**One question about the wellspring**
Did you supply power today to the place that actually shines? Not circling ████ / ████, but being lit yourself for a moment. If not, use 20 minutes tonight for a minimal contact—open it, stay, and leave nothing that has to be shown tomorrow.

**Heizhou’s evening prompt**
Wednesday evening most easily opens a midterm for the week: how many days remain, whether contact was enough, whether there is a trace that counts. That is a grading muscle, not a making muscle. The wellspring does not sit the midterm. Carry this: am I supplying power, or scoring the week at half-time?

pulses.summary_original:
周五好。基线是「整合收口」，不是办一场本周回顾展。

**今天轻轻碰一下**
- 未命名容器：一次短接触就够。打开旧图、旧界面或一句旧注释进去，不给这一周补闭幕式。
- 判断训练场：若看盘，只问有没有失效条件被触发。不给五天气候起标题，也不把它写成「这一周的判断课」。

外部服务权限、部署与数据链路可用性。

长期创作、日常责任与稳定照护的平衡。

**黑昼建议/引子**
周五这天最熟练的肌肉，是把本周碰过的都挂上墙：系统动过、盘看过、容器靠近过——一挂上，接触就变成展签。展览很像作品，其实是闭幕式。容器不参加周五闭幕。带着走：我是在靠近，还是在布展？

**心灵按摩**
一周不必在今天变成一个可搬运的形状。并排着结束，也算过完。你不是欠这一周一个总结的人。未完成的部分可以继续暗着，不必今晚点亮。

**放松/理解自己的一小步**
- 保底：下楼走一圈，或只看窗外一会儿。不把这次体验写成材料。
- 可选：若已经有点空、又发慌，用 12 分钟「我不服务任何人」——不问有没有用。

**今天别做什么**
不要为了「这一周得有个形状」去新开整合工程、系统重建，或把创作做成周报。

pulses.summary_en:
Happy Friday. The baseline is "closing the integration," not staging a retrospective of the week.

**Touch lightly today**
- The unnamed container: one short contact is enough. Open an old image, an old interface, or one old note and go in; do not add a closing ceremony to this week.
- Judgment training ground: if you look at the market, ask only whether any invalidation condition has been triggered. Do not title a five-day climate, and do not write it as "this week's judgment class."

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.

Balancing long-term creative work, daily responsibilities, and dependable care.

**Black Day's suggestion / prompt**
Friday's most practiced muscle is to hang everything touched this week on the wall: systems moved, markets watched, the container approached—once hung, contact becomes a wall label. An exhibition looks like a work, but it is a closing ceremony. The container does not attend Friday's closing. Carry this: am I approaching, or am I installing a show?

**A little reassurance**
A week does not have to become a portable shape today. Ending side by side still counts as having lived it. You are not someone who owes this week a summary. What remains unfinished can stay dark; it does not have to be lit tonight.

**One small step toward rest and self-understanding**
- Minimum: go downstairs for a loop, or only look out the window for a while. Do not write this experience as material.
- Optional: if you already have a little space and also feel unsettled, use 12 minutes of "I serve no one"—do not ask whether it is useful.

**What not to do today**
Do not open a new integration project, rebuild a system, or turn making into a weekly report just so "this week has a shape."

pulses.summary_original:
🌱 **源泉一问**
今天有没有真的给源泉供过电？
如果没有，不必觉得欠了谁，也不用赶工。今晚找个 20 分钟，哪怕只是打开 ████ 或那段未命名的片段静静坐一会儿，先靠近，不交差。

🌙 **晚上黑昼引子**
周日傍晚最隐蔽的消耗，是把靠近源泉当成周末的赎罪券——仿佛今晚碰一下，这两天的零散和没完成就能被瞬间销账。
源泉不是收银台，也不负责替日子消灾；你一想用它结账，艺术就又被降级成了苦役。

Did you really supply power to the wellspring today?
If not, do not feel you owe anyone, and do not rush the work. Find 20 minutes tonight—even if you only open ████ or sit quietly with that unnamed fragment. Come closer first; do not hand in an assignment.

**源泉一问**
今天有没有给源泉供电？
周一的事务和框架容易把人撑满，如果你今天还没碰过那个发光的地方，今晚不必做大动作——就留 20 分钟，不带预期地摸一下那团未命名的容器（████ / 装置 / 文本），甚至只是写下一句让你心跳快半拍的片段。

**晚上黑昼建议 / 引子**
周一傍晚最习惯的下意识是「发令枪」：总觉得碰源泉必须是一场新战役的起跑，于是先挑状态、清桌面、搭环境，把一次纯粹的接触拖成了严肃立项。
未命名容器从不认得工期，它怕的不是你动作太轻，而是你非要带上起跑架才肯进场。

*带着走：* 我今晚是在靠近发光的地方，还是在试图给自己鸣枪？

**One question about the wellspring**
Did you feed the wellspring today?
If you have not touched the glowing place, keep 20 minutes and touch that unnamed container (████ / installation / text), or write one line that skips your heartbeat.

**Heizhou's evening suggestion / prompt**
Monday evening's most habitual reflex is the starter pistol: touching the wellspring feels like the start of a new campaign, so you first pick a mood, clear the desk, set up the environment, and drag a pure contact into a solemn project kickoff.
The unnamed container never recognizes a work schedule. It is not afraid of your touch being too light; it is afraid that you will not enter unless you bring starting blocks.

*Take this with you:* Tonight, am I moving closer to the glowing place, or trying to fire a starting gun for myself?

pulses.summary_original:
傍晚了。

源泉一问：今天有没有给源泉真的供过电？如果没有，今晚用 20 分钟补一次最小接触——不是开工，是坐到发光的地方旁边。

晚上黑昼建议/引子：周二最隐蔽的税，是「普通日」。周一配仪式，今天配办事，容器就被挪到下一次艺术重日。它很少死于忙碌，更常死于你觉得这一天配不上它。带着走：我是在过普通的一天，还是在给源泉排班？

pulses.summary_en:
Evening.

One question about the wellspring: did you really supply power to the wellspring today? If not, use 20 minutes tonight for a minimum contact—not starting work, just sitting beside the place that glows.

Heizhou’s evening prompt: Tuesday’s most hidden tax is the “ordinary day.” Monday gets a ritual; today gets errands; the container is postponed to the next art-heavy day. It rarely dies of busyness; it more often dies of you deciding this day is not worthy of it. Carry this: am I living an ordinary day, or am I scheduling the wellspring?

pulses.summary_original:
九月中旬的早晨，不必先把自己接上任何管道。那些还在别人机器上通宵的劳动，不是你的呼吸。你先在。站在一个还没被用掉的早晨里，就已经够了。

放松 / 理解自己的一小步
保底：坐着把一杯水喝完，中途不拿手机。
可选：只听一首歌，听完之前不当成素材。

灵感日报
- [跨领域科研] 错门识字
  为什么有创作价值：字不该从眼睛进，却被逼着从气味或脚底进。别人在固定的脑子上教认假名；你能做成实验的是：一座只生成一次的场地，被禁止用“该用的感官”去读一张建筑图。误认表比正确率更像空间句法——城市露出的是它真正被握住的入口，不是它看起来像什么。
  创作路径：一页实验卡。景观冻死；输入是平面或轴线图；入口禁止视觉，改走气味或地面振动；输出一张误认表。残留物是这张表，不是再训一只认字的脑。
  材料：信息总结 hae.satoru.net 用 FlyWire 真脑接线教果蝇脑认假名 ████

- [AI艺术] 焊点名录
  为什么有创作价值：观众以为作品是那张全脑、那座生成世界。可署名的只有焊点：相机焊到哪根油门，人把哪根线接到哪块身体。蓝图完整也可以一步都没走。这是给你装置和课堂的作者权文件，不是再做一个手势无人机。
  创作路径：一页名录模板：冻结物 / 输入焊点 / 输出焊点 / 禁止宣称（抽搐不等于行走）。用一个虚构景观装置填完即算完成。
  材料：信息总结 SpikeCalls 手势控无人机 ████ ；村本 权重该学还是该量 ████ ；DIY Fly Simulation Guide ████

- [股票投资] 正确性章与████
  为什么有创作价值：机制说对了，不等于这件事被允许发生。别人在比便宜模型和贵模型谁更能审代码；你要的不是比价，是判断训练场缺的第二枚章——过了正确性，仍可能不准观察、不准公开、不准当成确认。
  创作路径：一页双章卡。选一个公共叙事（不写标的），先盖正确性，再单独盖许可。许可栏印死三句否决，不填进出。
  材料：AI日报候选 Luna 对 Astra 做代码评审 ████

- [公众号] 判官夜禁
  为什么有创作价值：通宵的是劳动，不是判断。把编排留给贵的、把长跑留给便宜的，人人都会说省钱。你能写成文章的独立论点是：判官一旦跟夜班同桌，确认会被劳动污染——写得多，不等于判过了。
  创作路径：一张班次表（夜班可写不可判 / 晨班可判不可写）加 800 字，不写模型比价教程。
  材料：AI日报候选 Astra 编排、Flash 干活 ████

pulses.summary_en:
Mid-September morning. You do not have to plug yourself into any pipe first. Labor still running overnight on other people's machines is not your breath. You are here first. Standing in a morning that has not yet been spent is already enough.

A small step toward rest and self-understanding
Minimum: sit and finish one glass of water without picking up the phone.
Optional: listen to one song only, and do not treat it as material before it ends.

Inspiration daily
- [Cross-domain research] Wrong-door literacy
  Why it has creative value: characters should not enter through the eyes, yet they are forced in through smell or the soles of the feet. Others train a fixed brain to read false names; what you can make as an experiment is a site generated only once, where the "proper sense" is forbidden from reading an architectural drawing. A table of misreadings is more like space syntax than accuracy—what a city reveals is the entrance it is actually held by, not what it looks like.
  Path: one experiment card. Freeze the landscape; the input is a plan or axial map; the entrance forbids vision and uses smell or ground vibration instead; the output is a misreading table. The residue is that table, not another literacy-trained brain.
  Material: web summary hae.satoru.net using FlyWire's real brain wiring to teach a fruit-fly brain false names ████

- [AI art] Weld-point register
  Why it has creative value: viewers think the work is the whole brain, the generated world. What can be signed are only the welds: which camera is welded to which throttle, which wire a person soldered onto which body. A complete blueprint can still mean not a single step was taken. This is an authorship file for your installation and classroom, not another gesture drone.
  Path: one register template: frozen object / input weld / output weld / forbidden claims (a twitch is not walking). Filling it with one fictional landscape installation counts as done.
  Material: web summary SpikeCalls gesture-controlled drone ████ ; Muramoto whether weights should be learned or measured ████ ; DIY Fly Simulation Guide ████

- [Stock investing] The correctness stamp and ████
  Why it has creative value: a correct mechanism is not the same as permission for the thing to happen. Others compare cheap and expensive models at reviewing code; what you need is not a price comparison, but the second stamp the training ground still lacks—after correctness, observation, publication, or confirmation may still be refused.
  Path: one dual-stamp card. Choose a public narrative (do not write an instrument). Stamp correctness first, then stamp permission separately. The permission column prints three dead vetoes and does not fill entries or exits.
  Material: AI daily candidate Luna reviewing Astra's code ████

- [Public account] Night ban for the judge
  Why it has creative value: what stays up all night is labor, not judgment. Leaving orchestration to the expensive and the long run to the cheap is what everyone calls saving money. The independent argument you can write is: once the judge sits with the night shift, confirmation is contaminated by labor—writing more is not the same as having judged.
  Path: one shift table (night shift may write but not judge / morning shift may judge but not write) plus 800 words, not a model-price tutorial.
  Material: AI daily candidate Astra orchestrates, Flash does the work ████

pulses.summary_original:
傍晚了。

**源泉一问**
今天有没有真的给源泉供电？不是想起它、说到它。如果没有，今晚用 20 分钟补一个最小动作：碰一块还湿着的东西，改一下或删一下。别立项。

**晚上黑昼建议/引子**
你给容器的器官起得越完整，越容易用复述代替接触。名字一齐，它看起来还在发光；其实发光的是词典。未命名的东西怕的不是含糊，是被说圆。带着走：我今晚是在靠近那个还没名字的东西，还是在温习一套已经够用的词？

pulses.summary_en:
Evening.

**One question about the wellspring**
Did you actually power the wellspring today? Not remembering it, not mentioning it. If not, spend 20 minutes tonight on the smallest action: touch something still wet, change it or delete it. Do not start a project.

**Heizhou’s evening prompt**
The more completely you name the container’s organs, the easier it is to replace contact with recitation. Once the names are all in place, it still looks as if it is glowing; what is glowing is the dictionary. What remains unnamed is not afraid of being vague; it is afraid of being rounded into a finished story. Carry this: tonight, am I approaching the thing that still has no name, or reviewing a set of words that is already enough?

pulses.summary_original:
傍晚校准，只问一件事：今天有没有给源泉供电？如果没有，今晚用 20 分钟补一个最小接触——不是把作品做完，是让手重新碰到发光的地方。

晚上黑昼建议/引子
周四最强的能力是并行：一边发生，一边看着发生。这副「第二观察者」的眼睛会跟着进容器，把接触做成同场直播。源泉不对解说发光。带着走：今晚这 20 分钟只许一只手在场，心里那块「这算不算」的屏幕先黑掉。

pulses.summary_en:
Evening calibration, only one question: did you supply power to the wellspring today? If not, use 20 minutes tonight for a minimal contact—not to finish a work, but to let the hand touch the glowing place again.

Evening Heizhou suggestion / prompt
Thursday’s strongest capacity is parallelism: something happens, and at the same time you watch it happen. This “second observer” eye will follow into the container and turn contact into a live co-presence. The wellspring does not glow for commentary. Take this with you: these 20 minutes tonight allow only one hand to be present; first black out the inner screen that asks “does this count?”

pulses.summary_original:
周五不用先证明自己配拥有这一天。窗外又在排队的是工具，它们很会给人进度感；你只要先把自己从睡眠里完整捞出来。身体醒了，容器才有地方可碰。

放松 / 理解自己的一小步
保底：喝完一杯水之前，不打开任何仓库。
可选：下楼走一圈。路上看见的东西，先别收成材料。

灵感日报
- [AI艺术] 第八种运镜
  为什么有创作价值：镜头一旦收成词典，地方就变成菜单。你的风景不是再多一条可点的运镜，而是那一下词典里没有的：人必须走过去，画面才合法。未命名容器要的是接触，不是更全的语法表。
  创作路径：一页约束。列出七种合法运镜，第八种只许写成观众的位移，不许写成提示词。留下这页，不生成样片。
  材料：AI日报候选 424 条电影镜头语法 ████

- [跨领域科研] 替身禁判
  为什么有创作价值：能替你答题、在新数据上跑，会让人误以为判决已经发生。你真正缺的不是会跑实验的虚拟作者，而是一张证人席：它可以被提问，椅子上写着不准写判决。工程跑通，不等于可以对外说。
  创作路径：三栏卡——能答 / 能跑 / 能对外说。拿自己一篇未公开的稿填完，第三列默认空白。留下这张卡。
  材料：AI日报候选 Paper2Agent ████

- [跨领域科研] 旧迷宫健身房
  为什么有创作价值：把已经走过的探索再放一遍，会变便宜、变快。那是健身房，不是新城市。别人在用旧树做低成本自我进化；你能认领的对象是禁令：旧迷宫只许练速度，不许给新走法发证。
  创作路径：一张实验卡。每条回放路径盖章「只练速度，不发证」。填三条即停，不重跑整棵树。
  材料：AI日报候选 Dream-RSI ████ ；AIBuildAI PostTrain ████

外部服务权限、部署与数据链路可用性。

- [公众号] 会开口的补丁
  为什么有创作价值：贴上去的记忆会说话。能被问出来的，还停在补丁层，没有进身体。别人在权衡私有知识能不能公开挂；你能写的第三物是：压缩如果还能被撬开，它就从来不是你的。
  创作路径：论点卡三句——能被问出的记忆 / 问不出来的判断 / 因此什么不准挂。扩成 800 字提纲，不写模型卡片教程。
  材料：信息总结 ClawHunt P6 私有知识 LoRA ████

pulses.summary_en:
Friday you do not have to prove you deserve this day first. What is lining up outside the window again is tools; they are good at giving a sense of progress. You only need to first pull yourself fully out of sleep. When the body is awake, the container has somewhere it can actually be touched.

A small step toward rest / self-understanding
Floor: do not open any repository before finishing a glass of water.
Optional: walk a loop downstairs. What you see on the road, do not harvest as material yet.

Inspiration daily
- [AI art] The eighth camera move
  Why it has creative value: once lenses are collected into a dictionary, place becomes a menu. Your landscape is not one more clickable camera move, but the one the dictionary does not have: a person has to walk there for the image to become legitimate. The unnamed container wants contact, not a more complete grammar table.
  Creative path: one page of constraints. List seven legal camera moves; the eighth may only be written as the viewer's displacement, never as a prompt. Leave this page; do not generate a sample.
  Material: AI daily candidate 424 cinematic lens grammars ████

- [Cross-domain research] Stand-in forbidden to judge
  Why it has creative value: being able to answer in your place, and to run on new data, can make people mistake the verdict as already delivered. What you actually lack is not a virtual author who can run experiments, but a witness chair: it can be questioned, and on the chair it says no verdicts. An engineering run succeeding is not the same as being allowed to say it in public.
  Creative path: a three-column card — can answer / can run / can say in public. Fill it with one of your unpublished drafts; the third column stays blank by default. Leave this card.
  Material: AI daily candidate Paper2Agent ████

- [Cross-domain research] Old maze gym
  Why it has creative value: replaying exploration already walked makes it cheaper and faster. That is a gym, not a new city. Others use old trees for low-cost self-evolution; the object you can claim is a prohibition: the old maze may only train speed, and may not certify a new way of walking.
  Creative path: one experiment card. Stamp every replay path “speed practice only, no certification.” Fill three and stop; do not rerun the whole tree.
  Material: AI daily candidate Dream-RSI ████ ; AIBuildAI PostTrain ████

External-service permissions, deployment, and data-path availability.

- [Public account] A patch that can speak
  Why it has creative value: memory pasted on will talk. What can still be pried out remains at the patch layer; it has not entered the body. Others weigh whether private knowledge can hang in public; the third thing you can write is: if compression can still be pried open, it was never yours.
  Creative path: a three-sentence argument card — memory that can be asked out / judgment that cannot be asked out / therefore what must not hang. Expand into an 800-word outline; do not write a model-card tutorial.
  Material: information summary ClawHunt P6 private-knowledge LoRA ████

pulses.summary_original:
源泉一问
今天有没有给源泉供电？如果没有——不用急着补完整，但今晚留 20 分钟，让一件小而真的东西发生。一段画面、一个动作、一句没想清楚的话都好，让它不必被这一周的任何一个词收编。

晚上黑昼建议/引子
周五傍晚最容易的不是累，是「今晚可以奢侈」。这听起来像奖赏，其实是一份判决书——它只承认这一周你赚到的部分，连身体的疲劳都自动升级成应得的奖品。源泉不收奖牌。它今晚只想知道这一周你有没有真的活过：包括那些没被画面收编的沉默、没被写进结论的犹豫、没被塞进任何一栏的半小时。今晚这 20 分钟不带奖牌进场。

pulses.summary_en:
One question about the wellspring
Did you feed the wellspring today? If not — no need to rush a complete catch-up, but leave 20 minutes tonight for one small and true thing to happen. A fragment of image, a gesture, or a sentence not yet thought through is enough, so it does not have to be absorbed by any word of this week.

Heizhou's evening prompt
The easiest thing on a Friday evening is not tiredness; it is “tonight can be a luxury.” That sounds like a reward, but it is a verdict — it only recognizes the part of the week you earned, and even the body's fatigue is automatically upgraded into a prize you deserve. The wellspring does not collect medals. Tonight it only wants to know whether you actually lived this week: including the silences not absorbed into images, the hesitations not written into conclusions, the half hour not stuffed into any column. These 20 minutes tonight do not enter with a medal.

🌙 Good night · September 18, 2026

No diary was left today, so this day will not be given a plot after the fact. Blankness is also a kind of accuracy: what was not written need not later be completed as if it “happened.”

Night has reached the place where it should stop. Leave the unfinished as it is; that is cleaner than forcing a close.

When you wake tomorrow, start from the one thing in front of you — there is no need to fill today's empty space first.

pulses.summary_original:
周六早晨还没真正开始。你不用先证明自己配得上这一天。容器还在，它不靠七点半给它起名字。先把自己从夜里捞出来就够。

**放松 / 理解自己的一小步**
- 保底：第一杯水喝完之前，不打开任何对话。
- 可选：站到窗边看外面动了什么，不拍照，不当素材。

**灵感日报**

我烦的是一对齐，两边就开始互相写评语。
**无字对账，拿来当今晚复盘的禁句协议**
以前两套判断一对齐，句子就来了，评语变成工作本身。这个想法让你能干的是：复盘时不许出现完整句子，只交换两张还没说出口的状态快照，再圈出翻译发生在哪一秒。从一张纸开始——左栏贴快照 A，右栏贴快照 B，中间只许画一条线，不许写因为。
🔗 链接：████
源项目在省掉说话这件事上找速度；你要留下的是那条线：翻译一旦发生，工作就变薄。

我老看见规划把落地也一块吞了。
**手不许懂为什么，拿来写一页两道门的装置说明**
以前意图一出口，手就跟着改目标，景观还没被碰到，剧本已经写完。这个想法让你能干的是：把“为什么”和“点哪里”拆成两道门。左门只能写一句意图，看不到场地；右门只能指出坐标，看不到意图。观众必须把一张纸条从左递到右，场地才亮。留下这页说明，不建模。
🔗 链接：████
源项目是小模型负责点哪里；你要的残留物是分工本身——手不许懂为什么，意图不许偷看像素。

我嫌公园一做成模拟，就只剩好看。
**打回的公园，拿来写一份会被判不合格的访问规格**
以前景观一开工，就忙着渲染、跑通、让它看起来像真的。这个想法让你能干的是：先写一页“公园访问规格”，哪些路径算合法，哪一步必须失败，失败了公园才成立。故意留一条走不通的边。留下规格，不跑仿真器。
🔗 链接：████
源项目把模拟写成可核对的规格；你要的不是更能跑的引擎，而是一份会打回观众的公园。

我真正吓到的不是拟人，是接错线之后它还走得通。
**错肢接线图，拿来当城市步态的错误说明书**
以前空间还在，只是入口、墙、座位被接到了不该接的器官上，城市照样运行，只是开始用手走路。这个想法让你能干的是：画一页接线图，把入口接到前肢，把展墙接到口器，把座位接到停栖。写三句第五天会发生的错用，然后停笔。留下这页，不绑任何身体数据。
🔗 链接：████
源项目是映射选对了，胳膊必然变前腿；你要的对象是那张表——城市还在走，只是改了物种。

我怕知识库一能自己长，接触就被续写顶掉。
**死页名单，拿来圈出永远不许系统替你续写的那几页**
以前文档一进框架，就又问答又推理又自己长百科，看起来什么都活着。这个想法让你能干的是：列三到五页死页——只能你亲手碰过才加一句，Agent 续写一律作废。从现有 wiki 里圈出来，写在名单上即停，不接新框架。
🔗 链接：████
源项目让文档自己长成可问的百科；你要留下的是相反的名单：有些页必须保持人工死掉，才算你还在场。

Saturday morning has not truly begun. You do not have to prove you deserve this day first. The container is still here; it does not need 7:30 to name it. Pulling yourself out of the night is enough.

**A small step toward rest / self-understanding**
- Minimum: do not open any conversation before the first glass of water is finished.
- Optional: stand by the window and watch what is moving outside; do not photograph it, and do not treat it as material.

**Inspiration daily**

What irritates me is that once two sides align, they start writing comments on each other.
**Wordless reconciliation, used as tonight's no-sentence review protocol**
Before, the moment two judgments lined up, sentences arrived, and commentary became the work itself. What this idea lets you do: no complete sentences in the review. Only exchange two still-unspoken state snapshots, then mark the second when translation happened. Start with one sheet of paper—snapshot A on the left, snapshot B on the right, only one line allowed in the middle, no because.
🔗 Link: ████
The source project looks for speed by skipping speech; what you keep is that line: once translation happens, the work thins.

I keep seeing plans swallow the landing as well.
**The hand is not allowed to know why, used to write one page of two-door installation notes**
Before, once intention was spoken, the hand changed the target with it; the landscape had not been touched, and the script was already written. What this idea lets you do: split “why” and “where to point” into two doors. The left door may write only one sentence of intention and cannot see the site; the right door may only point to coordinates and cannot see the intention. Only when a viewer passes a slip of paper from left to right does the site light up. Leave this page of notes; do not model.
🔗 Link: ████
The source project lets a small model decide where to point; the residue you want is the division itself—the hand may not know why, and intention may not peek at pixels.

I dislike how a park, once made into a simulation, is left only looking good.
**A park that sends you back, used to write an access spec that would fail inspection**
Before, once a landscape started, it rushed to render, to run through, to look real. What this idea lets you do: first write one page of “park access specifications”—which paths count as legal, which step must fail, and only by failing does the park hold. Deliberately leave one edge that cannot be walked. Leave the spec; do not run a simulator.
🔗 Link: ████
The source project writes simulation as a checkable spec; what you want is not a more runnable engine, but a park that can send the visitor back.

What truly frightens me is not anthropomorphism, but that after the wrong wires are attached it still walks.
**Wrong-limb wiring diagram, used as an error manual for a city’s gait**
The space was still there; only the entrance, wall, and seat were wired to organs they should not have. The city still ran, only it began to walk with hands. What this idea lets you do: draw one wiring page, attach the entrance to a forelimb, the exhibition wall to mouthparts, the seat to a perch. Write three sentences of the misuses that happen on the fifth day, then stop. Leave this page; bind no body data.
🔗 Link: ████
The source project says that if the mapping is right, an arm must become a foreleg; the object you want is that table—the city is still walking, only it changed species.

I am afraid that once a knowledge base can grow by itself, contact is overwritten by continuation.
**Dead-page list, used to circle the few pages a system may never continue for you**
Before, once a document entered the frame, it answered, reasoned, and grew an encyclopedia; everything looked alive. What this idea lets you do: list three to five dead pages—only a sentence you personally touched may be added; any Agent continuation is void. Circle them in the existing wiki, write them on the list, and stop; do not attach a new frame.
🔗 Link: ████
The source project lets documents grow into a askable encyclopedia; what you keep is the opposite list: some pages must stay humanly dead, or you are no longer present.

pulses.summary_original:
节奏、休息与自我观察。

**放松 / 理解自己的一小步**
保底：喝一口水，看窗外十二秒，不拍照。
可选：下楼走一圈，口袋里不放待办。

灵感日报

框进去的那块，多半已经死了。
**框外才算园，拿来写一页框选处决说明书**
以前做城市场景，一上手就忙着把建筑和路网收进模型，框里越完整越像完成。这个想法让你能干的是：先画一个框，框内只许变成标本，活的园在框外。写下五件只有掉在框外才存在的东西——小径、临时摊、被墙挡住的光、无名的空地、没人测绘的水。标本不许再被美化。一页即停，不导出任何三维。
🔗 链接：████
源工具是框一块城区导出带建筑的模型；你要留下的是那一刀——被框住的是尸体，园子从拒绝开始。

记得越久，越不像今天这片地。
**隔夜作废的园记，拿来写一条现场可训的遗忘章程**
以前景观一做好，记忆就越积越厚，讲解、风格、旧权重全赖着不走。这个想法让你能干的是：规定园记只能活一个白天。隔夜权重作废，第二天用当天拍的十几张照片，五分钟当场再训一个小得能扔的记性。章程只写三行：准许记住什么、天亮必须忘什么、谁有权按作废。写完贴在入口，不训练真模型。
🔗 链接：████
源项目是五分钟训一条能在浏览器聊的小鱼；你要的不是小模型，是一份合法健忘的园规。

下一帧最会骗人，力才老实。
**先交力再看下一帧，拿来写████的参观顺序**
以前预知下一秒，总是直接把未来画面递到眼前，好看，但你已经没判断了。这个想法让你能干的是：████。第一道只许交出一个力——挤、漏、压、刮，不许说物体名字；第二道只许指一块会动的质地；第三道才给下一帧。交不出力的人停在门外。先写半页顺序：每道门收什么、什么算作弊、谁被请出去。
🔗 链接：████
源方法把光流、点云、未来帧写成因果链；你要留下的是参观纪律——没交出过力，就不配看见下一步。

看第四眼的时候，人已经不在判断了。
**三次看完必须出门，拿来做一张离场练习卡**
以前把所有要盯的东西堆进同一页，看起来很专业，其实是在训练自己不离开。这个想法让你能干的是：同一块板只许看三次。三次之内必须写下：还成立 / 已失效 / 今晚不许再看。要看第四次，先把卡片出门，走到没屏幕的地方站一分钟。卡上只有这三格和出门时间，不写行情，不写理由。
🔗 链接：████
源项目是把自选和提醒做成能自己架的一页仪表盘；你要留下的是相反的训练——判断有看次上限，不是信息有上限。

新技能一来，旧的那个器官就该让位。
**换器官不添抽屉，拿来填一张零和替换卡**
以前系统一不顺就加技能、加工具、加一个能办事的新房间，抽屉越来越满，接触越来越少。这个想法让你能干的是：想引进任何新技能，必须先杀掉一个旧器官。卡上四栏：要进来的、被换掉的、它曾经替你干什么、换掉之后哪件事你得亲手做。填不出来就不准加。一张卡即停，不改装系统。
🔗 链接：████
████在讲技能堆多了是陷阱；你要留下的不是另一套起步模板，是替换本身——器官可以换，抽屉不许增。

pulses.summary_en:
Pace, rest, and self-observation.

**A small step toward rest / understanding yourself**
Minimum: take a sip of water, look out the window for twelve seconds, take no photo.
Optional: go downstairs for a loop, with no to-do list in your pocket.

Inspiration daily

Whatever is framed in is mostly already dead.
**The garden is outside the frame; use this to write one page of a frame-as-execution manual**
When making urban scenes, the first reflex used to be packing buildings and road networks into the model; the more complete the frame, the more it looked finished. What this idea lets you do: draw a frame first. Inside it, things may only become specimens; the living garden is outside. Write down five things that exist only if they fall outside the frame—a path, a temporary stall, light blocked by a wall, unnamed vacant ground, unmapped water. Specimens may not be beautified again. Stop at one page; export no 3D.
🔗 Link: ████
The source tool frames a piece of city and exports a model with buildings; what you keep is that cut—whatever is framed is a corpse, and the garden begins in refusal.

The longer it is remembered, the less it resembles this ground today.
**Garden notes that expire overnight; use this to write a field-trainable charter of forgetting**
Once a landscape is made, memory only thickens: commentary, style, and old weights refuse to leave. What this idea lets you do: garden notes may live only one daylight. Overnight weights expire. The next day, with a dozen photos taken that day, retrain in five minutes a memory small enough to throw away. The charter is only three lines: what may be remembered, what must be forgotten at dawn, and who has the right to press expire. Write it and post it at the entrance; do not train a real model.
🔗 Link: ████
The source project trains a small fish that can chat in the browser in five minutes; what you want is not the small model, but a garden rule of lawful forgetfulness.

The next frame is the best liar; force is honest.
**Hand over force before seeing the next frame; use this to write ████'s visiting order**
When the next second is known in advance, the future picture is handed to the eye; it looks good, but judgment is already gone. What this idea lets you do: ████. The first gate may only surrender a force—squeeze, leak, press, scrape—no object names; the second gate may only point at a moving texture; the third gate finally gives the next frame. Anyone who cannot hand over force stays outside. First write half a page of order: what each door collects, what counts as cheating, who is asked to leave.
🔗 Link: ████
The source method writes optical flow, point clouds, and future frames as a causal chain; what you keep is visiting discipline—without having given force, you are not entitled to the next step.

By the fourth look, a person is no longer judging.
**Leave after three looks; use this to make an exit-practice card**
Stacking everything that must be stared at onto one page looks professional; it actually trains you not to leave. What this idea lets you do: the same board may be looked at only three times. Within three looks you must write: still holds / already expired / tonight you may not look again. To look a fourth time, first take the card out the door and stand one minute where there is no screen. The card has only these three boxes and the exit time; write no quotes, no reasons.
🔗 Link: ████
The source project turns watchlists and alerts into a self-hosted one-page dashboard; what you keep is the opposite training—judgment has a look-count limit, not information.

New skills arrive, the old organ should yield.
**Swap organs, do not add drawers; use this to fill a zero-sum replacement card**
When a system stalls, the reflex used to be add a skill, add a tool, add a room that can get things done; drawers fill, contact thins. What this idea lets you do: to bring in any new skill, you must first kill an old organ. Four columns on the card: what comes in, what is replaced, what it used to do for you, and which thing you must do by hand after the swap. If you cannot fill it, you may not add. Stop at one card; do not rebuild the system.
🔗 Link: ████
████ is talking about stacked skills as a trap; what you keep is not another starter template, but replacement itself—organs may be swapped, drawers may not grow.

pulses.summary_original:
**源泉一问**
今天有没有真的给源泉供电？想过它、排过它、给它留过位置，都不算。没有的话，今晚用 20 分钟补一个最小接触。

**晚上黑昼建议/引子**
「艺术重日」傍晚会把供电偷换成推进。你一问今天走了没有，未命名容器就降成项目。电路是反的：源泉不是作品的充电器，是你被点亮的插座。带着走：我是在给作品续电，还是让自己重新带电？

pulses.summary_en:
**One question about the wellspring**
Did you really supply power to the wellspring today? Thinking about it, scheduling it, leaving it a slot—none of that counts. If not, spend 20 minutes tonight on the smallest contact.

**Evening prompt from Heizhou**
On an "art-heavy day," evening will steal power-supply and swap it for progress. The moment you ask whether today moved, the unnamed container drops into a project. The circuit is reversed: the wellspring is not the work's charger; it is the socket that lights you. Carry this: am I topping up the work, or letting myself become charged again?

pulses.summary_original:
**心灵按摩**
九月下旬的早上，先不用把自己拧成“该干活了”。身体醒了，判断还在后头，这很正常。那个还没名字的容器，不靠你七点半就定义它；它只需要你今天还有一条能真正碰上的接触线。连续会被切断，短的真实接触仍然算。

**放松 / 理解自己的一小步**
保底：喝完一杯东西之前，不打开任何要你回复的窗口。
可选：下楼走一圈，只数自己经过几扇还没醒的窗。不用拍照，也不用变成材料。

**灵感日报**

能转着看的过去，其实你已经不在里面了。
**时间盒子禁旋，拿来写一页禁止轨道的装置约束**
以前做一段动作，总想叠成能转的半透明盒子，观众一转就“看懂了刚才”。这个想法让你能干的是：园里可以有体积化的过去，但任何轨道、转盘、拖拽都被开除。人只能站在此刻那一层，侧面那些层是挡路的密度，不是时间轴。一页约束写完即停：禁什么相机、过去以什么方式挡路、出口只许带走一句“哪一秒我没看见”。
🔗 链接：████
源演示把几秒动作收成可旋转的盒子；你要留下的是相反的园规——过去可以占体积，不许被浏览。

说出口的那句，最不该有后悔权。
**出口句钉地，拿来走一条只增不改的园路**
以前给地方起名，总能回头改口：刚才那是廊，现在改成厅。这个想法让你能干的是：嘴里出去的第一句地名，当场钉在地上。后面只能加词，不许替换。走完画出钉句平面：哪句钉在哪、哪句是后来追加、哪句如果改了园就作废。一张图即停，不录音，不训练语音模型。
🔗 链接：████
源系统是吐出的字幕不再改口；你要留下的是空间法——改名等于拆路。

更好的那句咒语，往往在替你逃作业。
**交卷是考卷不是咒语，拿来写一页十二题落第规格**
以前布置生成课，学生交的是一段越写越长的提示词，你也只能围着那句话改。这个想法让你能干的是：作业不许交咒语。必须交十二道题：这张图或这片园在哪六种情况下必须失败，哪六种必须站住。你改的是考卷，不是那句话。一页规格：题怎么出、什么算作弊交咒语、谁有权改题。写完不示范任何提示词。
🔗 链接：████
████让人别再改咒语去搭评测环；你要留下的是课业纪律——交不出落第条件，就不配生成。

两个判官说一样的话，那格就可以扔。
**分歧格才归档，拿来做一张只收吵架的训练卡**
以前复盘，总想证明谁对。这个想法让你能干的是：冻住同一场画面——一张图、一段路、一页旧笔记——两个判官各自写成立或失效，不许商量。一致的格子划掉；只把吵架的那几格贴进卡里。卡上三栏：他看见什么、我看见什么、今晚谁也不许赢。不写买卖，不写对错结论。
🔗 链接：████
源对比是同一盘棋、本地小模型和云端大模型对打；你要留下的是训练物——资产是分歧，不是胜负。

pulses.summary_en:
**Mind massage**
Late September morning: you do not have to twist yourself into "time to work." The body is awake; judgment is still behind. That is normal. The still-unnamed container does not need you to define it at 7:30; it only needs one contact line you can actually touch today. Continuity will be cut. Short real contact still counts.

**A small step toward rest / self-understanding**
Minimum: do not open any window that asks you to reply until you have finished one drink.
Optional: go downstairs and walk a loop, counting only the windows that are still asleep. No photos, and do not turn it into material.

**Inspiration daily**

A past you can spin through is a past you are already not inside.
**Ban rotation on the time-box; use it to write one page of apparatus constraints that forbid tracks**
You used to want a stretch of motion stacked into a translucent box the audience could spin to "get what just happened." What this lets you make: the garden may have a volumetric past, but every track, turntable, and drag is expelled. A person may only stand on the present layer; the side layers are blocking density, not a timeline. Stop when one page of constraints is done: which cameras are banned, how the past blocks the way, and that the exit may take only one sentence—"which second I did not see."
Link: ████
The source demo packs a few seconds of motion into a rotatable box; what you keep is the opposite garden rule—the past may occupy volume, it may not be browsed.

The sentence spoken aloud should have the least right to regret.
**Nail the exit sentence to the ground; use it to walk a garden path that only adds, never revises**
You used to name a place and then recant: that was a corridor, now it is a hall. What this lets you make: the first place-name out of the mouth is nailed to the ground on the spot. Later you may only add words, never replace them. After walking, draw a plan of nailed sentences: which sentence is nailed where, which was appended later, which would void the garden if changed. Stop at one drawing. No recording. No speech-model training.
Link: ████
The source system is subtitles that do not take back their words; what you keep is spatial law—renaming equals tearing up the path.

The better spell is often helping you flee the assignment.
**Handing in is an exam paper, not a spell; use it to write one page of a twelve-question failing spec**
You used to assign generation classwork and students handed in a prompt that grew longer, and you could only revise that sentence. What this lets you make: homework may not be a spell. It must be twelve questions: in which six cases this image or this garden must fail, and in which six it must hold. You revise the exam paper, not the sentence. One page of spec: how questions are set, what counts as cheating by handing in a spell, who may change the questions. When it is written, do not demonstrate any prompt.
Link: ████
████ asks people to stop rewriting spells and to build an evaluation loop instead; what you keep is classroom discipline—if you cannot hand in the failing conditions, you are not qualified to generate.

If two judges say the same thing, that cell can be thrown away.
**Only archive the disagreement cells; use them to make a training card that only collects arguments**
You used to review in order to prove who was right. What this lets you make: freeze the same scene—one image, one path, one old page of notes—and have two judges each write hold or fail, no conferring. Strike the cells that agree; paste only the arguing cells onto the card. Three columns: what he sees, what I see, tonight nobody is allowed to win. No buying or selling, no verdict of right and wrong.
Link: ████
The source comparison is the same game of chess, a local small model versus a cloud large model; what you keep as training matter is the disagreement, not the win.

Simon，傍晚了。

源泉一问
今天有没有真的给源泉供过电？不是围着它转过，是你自己被点亮过一会儿。如果没有，今晚用 20 分钟补一个最小动作——先靠近，不交差。

晚上黑昼建议/引子
周一的接触不过夜。你最容易在周二出示昨天的章：昨天已经是艺术重日，今天就免检。通行证很像纪律，其实是把发光做成了有效期。容器没有次日有效。带着走：我是在供电，还是在核销昨天那一次？

pulses.summary_original:
秋天的早上不用一睁眼就证明你还在线上。身体可以先到，判断晚一点来也行。我在，不催。

**放松 / 理解自己的一小步**
- 保底：窗边或楼下站两分钟，不回消息。
- 可选：听完一首歌再碰屏幕。

灵感日报

能自己造句的时候，路其实已经在撒谎。
**选项外无路，拿来写一页只能点不能说的园规**
以前走园、写判断，总忍不住补一句解释，路就越走越宽，像完成了。这个想法让你能干的是：出门前钉死七个已经在场的去处，整段只能用手指点其中一个。想说第八个，这段作废。一页园规即停：七个合法对象、什么算偷说新词、点完必须立刻出门。写完不训练任何分类器。
🔗 链接：████
源工具是答案只能落在列出的选项上；你要留下的是空间法——园不会生成新路，只会指认旧路。

表面漂亮，中间对不上，人其实已经掉下去了。
**对不上的那一格是坑，拿来画一张必须对账的地层剖面**
以前做合成景观，顶层一漂亮就交差，下面几层有没有对上，没人查。这个想法让你能干的是：画八层剖面，每一层必须能指到下一层的收据。对不上的那一格画成坑，人站上去会掉。一张剖面即停：哪些层要对账、什么叫收据、哪一格是坑。不重做任何渲染器。
🔗 链接：████
源工作是中间结果必须逐块对上；你要留下的是园的诚实——漂亮但对不上账的地面，就是洞。

人站在里面，不等于进过园。
**眼动才算进园，拿来做一张只收注视轨迹的到访证明**
以前到访证明是照片、模型、骨架，站过就算出过场。这个想法让你能干的是：身体可以在，但不算。只有眼睛在哪停过，才是官方地图。证明上三栏：看过哪、停了多久、哪一段故意没看。照片和骨架一律不算附件。一张卡即停，不训练注视模型。
🔗 链接：████
源演示是纸上小动物会盯鼠标；你要留下的是到访法——进园的不是身体，是目光有没有付过账。

整段重来，多半是在逃这一截的难看。
**只许重走这一截，拿来写一张禁止全片重渲的接触卡**
以前一段路不好看，就想把整天、整园、整部片子重做。这个想法让你能干的是：前面那些截路冻住，哪怕难看。只许重走脚底下这一截，十二分钟，超时出门。卡上四格：冻住的截、正在走的截、不许动的上一截、出门时间。填完不打开任何长镜头工作流。
🔗 链接：████
源节点是分段生成、只重做当前这一截；你要留下的是接触纪律——可以补这一脚，不许重写整条命。
